svg.text: Comprehensive MEGFlow stages and selectable modules
Level 3: code-derived comprehensive view of all stages, branch conditions, modules, and output families.
MEG: BIDS raw or raw files/dirs (.fif, .ds, 4D/BTI suffixes)
Anatomy: optional T1w BIDS, NIfTI, DICOM, or existing SUBJECTS_DIR
steps: report, anatomy, all, meg_all, meg_artifacts, meg_ica, meg_epochs
